title: Band-9 Samples: What do you do with photos you take? [Why/Why not?]
content:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 11 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 3 question:

“What do you do with photos you take? [Why/Why not?]”

Sample 1

In today’s digital age, I usually upload the snapshots I take onto social media platforms. This way, I can share my experiences and the places I visit with my social circle. I find that this not only helps me stay connected with my friends, but it also sparks conversations about shared interests or prompts others to share their own experiences.

Sample 2

Photographs, for me, are invaluable keepsakes. Once I’ve captured a moment with my camera, I love to incorporate these images into scrapbooks. This hobby allows me to preserve my experiences in a tangible format that I can revisit whenever I wish. Plus, the act of scrapbooking itself is incredibly soothing. In an increasingly digital world, having a physical reminder of my adventures feels refreshingly authentic.

Sample 3

I usually archive the pictures I capture in a digital photo album. Photos are a reflection of my experiences, almost like a visual journal. They help me recall various pivotal moments and the emotions associated with them. It’s always a joy to look back at these snapshots and reminisce about the past.

Sample 4

I take a lot of photos with the intention of using them to adorn my living space. I select the best ones, have them professionally printed, and then frame them. It’s a process that allows me to personalize my home with beautiful scenes from my travels or images of loved ones.

Sample 5

My photographs primarily serve as a source of inspiration for my artistic endeavors. As an amateur painter, I find the nuances of light and shadow captured in these images invaluable. They help me translate the vibrancy of life onto canvas, providing a visual record I can refer back to when my memory fails me.

Sample 6

As a freelance writer, I use my photographs to enhance my online presence. They add a personal touch to my website and social media profiles, which can help me stand out in the competitive field. Thus, these images serve as a crucial component of my personal branding strategy.

Sample 7

Photography, for me, serves as a form of emotional self-care. I often revisit my images when I’m feeling down, reminiscing about happy times or beautiful places I’ve visited. It’s a therapeutic process, offering a much-needed escape from the stresses of daily life. This might not be the conventional use of photographs, but it’s an effective coping mechanism that brings me immense comfort.

Sample 8

I often employ photographs as a means of documenting significant milestones in my life. Whether it’s celebrating a birthday, a graduation, or a new job, these images serve as tangible reminders of these moments. They allow me to reminisce about the past and appreciate how far I’ve journeyed.

Sample 9

As an aspiring professional photographer, I take my photos quite seriously. After each shoot, I scrutinize my work, selecting the best images to include in my portfolio. This collection is critical for showcasing my skills to potential clients or employers. It’s a continuous process of self-improvement and an essential step toward building my career in photography.

Sample 10

Due to my limited tech-savviness, the photos I take often end up lost somewhere in the vast storage of my smartphone or computer. I don’t really know how to properly manage them, and honestly, I’m not too bothered about it. I take photos more out of habit than a genuine desire to keep them.
